F01_witness.finite_carrier: density operators in D(C^2); finite genuine word plus finite single-base lift schedules
F01_witness.finite_operator: genuine Ti/Fi/WeylL/Te/Fe/WeylR channels vs same-base H0 lift channels
F01_witness.finite_path: forward and reversed finite words; forward-then-reversed vs forward-then-forward residual

claim_ceiling: Bounded deflation POC. It tests whether a single fixed Hopf base with only spin^c/connection lift choices can reproduce the existing order gap and order-discriminating irreversibility. No layer completion, manifold admission, bridge, flux, FEP, physics, or ratchet-edge admission.

forbidden_nonbase_axis_control_not_used_.description: This intentionally changes axes/channel families, so it is not a single-base spin^c deflation. It proves the metric can see order gaps when noncommuting structure is smuggled in.

connection_dressed_same_base_dephase.description: same H0 lift plus same-base dephasing; dissipative but no distinct layer/channel family

lift_only.description: single fixed Hopf base H0; U_m=exp(-i angle_m H0); only spin^c lift angle varies

deflated_construction.fixed_base: single Hopf base H0 = hopf_h0(2pi*0.21, 2pi*0.13, pi/4)
deflated_construction.forbidden_in_deflated_verdict: changing base axis, jump basin, dephasing basis, Weyl chirality channel, terrain channel, or composing genuine layer families
deflated_construction.varied_only: spin^c/connection lift angles on the same H0

genuine_construction.note: raw recovery is reported, but verdict uses order-discriminating irreversibility: rev(fwd(rho)) vs fwd(fwd(rho)).
genuine_construction.word: Ti Fi WeylL Te Fe WeylR forward vs reversed

noise_floor.definition: eps(Float64) * max PTM HS scale * word_depth(6) * 8 safety
noise_floor.match_tolerance_note: absolute 0.05 tolerance dominates numerical floor; target gap is ~0.35, so this is a permissive deflation match bar.

reused_from: order_null_killtest.jl genuine channels: Ti/Fi/WeylL/Te/Fe/WeylR definitions copied verbatim; same seed and density-operator construction.

tool_manifest.LinearAlgebra: load_bearing: density operators, channel composition, trace norms, PTM scale, Hopf-base generator.
tool_manifest.Random: load_bearing: same spinor-derived rho ensemble as order_null_killtest.
tool_manifest.Z3: load_bearing: measured same-gap/same-irreversibility reproduction is UNSAT for genuine-vs-deflated and SAT for flat controls.

verdict.reading: single fixed Hopf base with only spin^c/connection lift choices cannot reproduce the genuine order gap or order-discriminating irreversibility; ORDER-NULL survives this deflation control as a genuine multi-channel order DOF candidate.

z3_verdict_flip.encoding: single_base_reproduces => abs_scaled_delta <= scaled_tolerance; measured literals supplied from genuine-vs-best-deflated gap and irreversibility.
